mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 61 degrees with clear skies over Harriet Park and a third quarter moon, and we will see an overnight low of 51 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

October is officially Community Planning Month, recognizing the expertise of our development team, while the Verona Senior Center is currently offering free rides on their tri-shaw bikes for seniors along the Military Ridge State Trail.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, plus the World Dairy Expo and Farley Center Fall Festival coming up tomorrow.
Looking at the recent police activity, on September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for retail theft involving candy at a local shop.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, Really Reese's, before they close their doors at 10:30 PM tonight.
